name: SillyTavern
description: SillyTavern character card source adapter — exposes /discover for the library.

server.reason: Accepts HTTP requests and routes GET /, GET /card/:id, GET /thumb/:filename, and GET /discover to the SillyTavern character card handlers.

characters.reason: Lists PNG/WebP files in the characters directory and reads their raw bytes for card metadata extraction, raw download, and thumbnail serving.

meta_cache.reason: SQLite cache for parsed card metadata (name, description, tags, cached_at); populated lazily per page via INSERT OR REPLACE and read back via SELECT to avoid re-parsing PNG iTXt chunks on every request.

time.reason: Timestamps card metadata cache entries. Without it, cached_at is recorded as 0 (epoch); caching still works but timestamps are meaningless.
